admissions_discharge_complete.name: admissions_discharge_complete
admissions_discharge_complete.value:
("admissions"."discharged_at" IS NULL AND "admissions"."discharged_by" IS NULL AND "admissions"."discharge_disposition" IS NULL)
      OR ("admissions"."discharged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "admissions"."discharged_by" IS NOT NULL AND "admissions"."discharge_disposition" IS NOT NULL)

documents_void_has_reason.name: documents_void_has_reason
documents_void_has_reason.value:
("documents"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "documents"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("documents"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("documents"."void_reason")) > 0)

encounters_lifecycle.name: encounters_lifecycle
encounters_lifecycle.value:
("encounters"."status" = 'open' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "encounters"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("encounters"."status" = 'closed' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("encounters"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("encounters"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

invitations_acceptance_matches_status.name: invitations_acceptance_matches_status
invitations_acceptance_matches_status.value:
("invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL)

patients_unidentified_reasons.name: patients_unidentified_reasons
patients_unidentified_reasons.value: ("patients"."no_phone_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'unidentified' AND "patients"."no_id_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'unidentified') OR "patients"."unidentified"

price_changes_decision.name: price_changes_decision
price_changes_decision.value:
("price_changes"."status" = 'pending' AND "price_changes"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("price_changes"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "price_changes"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "price_changes"."decided_by" <> "price_changes"."requested_by")
      OR ("price_changes"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "price_changes"."decided_by" = "price_changes"."requested_by" AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)
